sql_expression: l.meeting_key = r.meeting_key AND l.session_name = 'Qualifying' AND r.session_name = 'Race' AND NOT COALESCE(l.is_cancelled, FALSE) AND NOT COALESCE(r.is_cancelled, FALSE)
description: Role-playing session join: l is main Qualifying, r is main Race. Excludes Sprint Qualifying. Filter the left input to Qualifying for this path. To compare grids to results, also match grid.driver_id to the Race entry.driver_id; otherwise this path expands to all entrants.
